text:
Platinum Price in 2009
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2009, the LBMA platinum price rose 48.6% between 2009-01-30 ($983) and 2009-12-30 ($1,461). The highest sampled price was $1,461 in December and the lowest was $983 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,214. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
